newsitem.title: USA: Schlumberger Q2 boosted by North America.
newsitem.headline: Schlumberger Q2 boosted by North America.

text.p: Schlumberger Ltd reported Wednesday a 21 percent increase in second quarter revenues, saying North American oilfield services were the largest driver of revenue growth.
Net income was $307 million and earnings per share were $0.62, reflecting gains of 56 and 55 percent, respectively, compared with the second quarter of 1996.
The company said total oilfield services revenue grew 30 percent as the rig count worldwide grew 17 percent, boosting operating income 69 percent.
It said North American revenue increased 32 percent, representing 19 percent of consolidated revenue, as the rig count increased 31 percent.

All businesses, particularly activities such as wireline logging and pressure pumping services, reported healthy advances, fueled by high activity in the Gulf of Mexico, a significant rise in land activity and favorable weather in Canada during the spring breakup, Schlumberger said.
The company said the rig count increased two percent outside North America with revenue 28 percent, representing 53 percent of consolidated revenue.
"Our businesses across all geographic regions were well positioned to take advantage of strong upswings in activity, led by Latin America, Africa and the Far East."

Measurement & Systems revenue increased four percent, while operating income grew 26 percent compared with the same period last year, Schlumberger said. The increase in operating results was due to Automatic Test Equipment, it added.
